accounts_help: Enter remembered account names as shown in the NetEase login dropdown, one per line. Use masked phone numbers or full email addresses. Optional OCR aliases: account#alias1#alias2. Enter a single line to switch to one account.
account_modes_help: Use SDK identities without #aliases as keys, e.g. {"account@example.com":{"android":"plan","ios":"daily"}}. Android: plan/login/off. iOS: daily/login/off. Missing modes default to plan/daily. Each platform follows the account-list order.
account_targets_help: Example: {"account@example.com":{"jade_receiver":"Main A","assist_friend":"Friend B"}}. Targets are independent; empty values inherit their corresponding global defaults.
apple_or_android_help: Default platform for pure manual switching when both routines are disabled. Enabled selects Android; disabled selects iOS. Scheduled routines use their own fixed platforms.
auto_jade_help: Only for pure manual switching with both routines disabled. Routines separately track one successful cooperation per receiver and refresh period.
account_switch_invite_friend_name_help: Legacy jade receiver. Per-account jade_receiver and the global jade receiver take priority. This is not an implicit borrowed-assist friend. The receiver must be online and accept the invitation.
account_jade_receiver_help: Android jade invitations only. Empty falls back to the legacy invitation name. Per-account targets take priority; each receiver has an independent refresh-period quota.
account_assist_friend_help: Friend whose assist shikigami is selected before Android awakening. Independent of the jade receiver; configure a valid friend when awakening is needed. Per-account assist_friend takes priority.
account_routine_enable_help: Selects the Android plan. Enable this task's scheduler and start OASX to wait for a future appointment. Daytime: jade only. Evening: daily chores, jade, awakening. Past appointments are not immediately replayed.
account_ios_daily_enable_help: Independent iOS schedule and progress. Switch to iOS and run selected free daily actions only; no jade, exploration or awakening. Daily records reset at 00:00.
account_ios_daily_run_time_help: Default 20:00. Any clock time is allowed. Daily and login records reset at 00:00, independently of Android jade refreshes at 06:00/18:00.
account_platform_priority_help: android first or ios first, only when both plans are due. Future work is never run early. Each platform retains account-list order.
account_daytime_run_time_help: Default 17:00, between 06:00 and 18:00. Jade only, with independent receiver groups. Completed receiver groups skip further invitations; login-only accounts remain independent.
account_evening_run_time_help: Default 20:00, after 18:00. Each alt runs daily chores, jade if its receiver group still needs it, then awakening.
account_daytime_jitter_minutes_help: 0–180, default ±15; 0 is fixed. Persist one draw per daytime window, bounded to 06:00–18:00. Restarting does not redraw.
account_evening_jitter_minutes_help: 0–180, default ±15; 0 is fixed. 20:00 ±15 means 19:45–20:15. One draw per evening window, independently persisted retries.
account_ios_daily_jitter_minutes_help: 0–180, default ±15; 0 is fixed. One persisted draw per 00:00-to-00:00 calendar day, independent of Android jade windows.
account_awakening_layer_help: Layers 1 to 10; default 1. Solo battles with no team invitation.
account_awakening_count_help: Default target 14. Verify the selected assist and current normal-dungeon usage first. Confirmed 14/15 or 15/15 skips awakening. Daily usage resets at 00:00; yesterday's wins do not reduce today's target. Observed usage and actual script wins are stored separately; unreadable counts never become zero.
account_awakening_kirin_help: lightning, fire, wind or water; default lightning. Solo challenges on the configured layer.
account_retry_minutes_help: Default 10 minutes. Resume unfinished steps without carrying a jade retry across its refresh boundary.
account_daily_free_options_help: Only friend_love, luck_msg and store_sign booleans. {} inherits existing Daily Trifles settings; explicit true/false overrides that action locally. No summons or stamina purchases.
account_daily_courtyard_affairs_help: Run courtyard affairs during the evening routine with per-account checkpoints.
account_daily_pickup_email_help: Collect mail during the evening routine; skip accounts already done.
